newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pam & Frank year net loss HK$368.72 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pam & Frank year net loss HK$368.72 mln.

text.p: Shr (H.K. cents) 86 loss vs 10 gain (see note)
Company name Pam & Frank International Holdings Ltd
NOTE - Pam & Frank International makes sports bags.

Net is after an exceptional loss of HK$29.67 million on property deposits paid for a proposed container consolidation services project and deposits for other proposed projects, HK$82.62 million on provision for doubtful debts of China debtors and others, HK$52.59 million on provision against inventories, HK$23.02 million on provision against prepayments and other debtors, HK$27.11 million on consignment sales of raw materials, HK$15.42 million on disposal of an associated company, HK$5.2 million on provision for legal claims by a freight forwarder, HK$20.71 million on provision for property deposits and HK$3.18 million for others.

The summary of results and assets and liabilities has been restated to reflect the adoption of the provisions of Hong Kong Statement of Accounting Practice No. 17 in accordance with the group's revised accounting policy.
Total dividend for year is nil vs 1.5 H.K. cent.
